info.title: Jira platform JAS-47 corrections and deprecations

actions.description: Import the pinned ADF 57.3.4 definitions into the existing component registry with collision-safe names.
actions.x-as-reason: Comment and worklog fields need a local, complete ADF schema graph whose references remain resolvable after import.

actions.description: Correct the generated source pointer components.schemas.Comment.properties.body to the documented Atlassian Document Format body.
actions.x-as-reason: The comment body description already declares ADF, but the generated schema omitted its structural constraint.

actions.description: Correct the generated source pointer components.schemas.Worklog.properties.comment to the documented Atlassian Document Format comment.
actions.x-as-reason: The worklog comment description already declares ADF, but the generated schema omitted its structural constraint.

actions.description: Remove the generated empty-string array-item default at /rest/api/3/classification-levels GET parameter 0.
actions.x-as-reason: An empty default lies outside the parameter item enum and makes the compiled schema internally inconsistent.

actions.x-as-reason: An empty default lies outside the parameter item enum and makes the compiled schema internally inconsistent.
